gen-gf-bellota-gf-biz-udpmincho: Bellota draws every stroke like a single stylus pass, with an s whose ends swing far from its spine. BIZ UDPMincho, a text serif, softens that with mild thicks and clear gaps.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-bona-nova: Distinctive and a bit commanding, Bellota traces each letter as if with one marker, its s ends hanging well away from the spine. Bona Nova, a text serif, takes over with a restrained swell and open curves that keep a long read moving.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-bona-nova-sc: Bellota keeps its strokes flat, with no shading, and lets its s ends drift wide of the spine. And Bona Nova SC adds a faint charcoal-like pressure, leaving its small counters unclogged.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-brawler: Pen-line swagger, all one weight, with s ends hanging far from the spine: that is Bellota. Brawler, a classic serif, then carries a long passage with rounded, open letters and softly varied strokes.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-brygada-1918: Bellota keeps its lines unshaded, with no hairline-to-stem shift, and its s ends hang far out. Brygada 1918, a text serif, does the opposite job: sturdy hairlines and a wide-open ring of a c.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-cactus-classical-serif: Cactus Classical Serif is authoritative, with a wide-open e and bowls that gain weight gently. Bellota then adds its flat, sign-painter's line and far-hanging s, so the two feel like a stencil beside a classic serif.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-caudex: Bellota runs unshaded, constant strokes, and its s ends hang far off the spine. Caudex, a text serif, reads dignified over a long passage, with gaping e mouths and thin strokes barely lighter than the thick.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-chiron-sung-hk: Pencil-sketched letters that never press harder define Bellota. Chiron Sung HK, a serif, reads steadily over a long stretch, its light modulation showing only up close and its curve ends set wide.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-cinzel: Cinzel is a classic, editorial text serif with loose tracking and a mellow thick-thin shift. Cinzel reads gracefully over a long passage, while Bellota's hollow glass-tube lines and far-hanging s add a distinctive heading.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-diphylleia: Bellota looks like glass tubing bent into letters, with no thickness variation and an s whose ends hang far from the spine. Diphylleia's moderate contrast is the strongest single quality here.
